title: UL residual emission (Cauchy stress over current configuration)
objective: Extend `emit_internal_force_kernel` to emit an Updated-Lagrangian residual integrand — Cauchy stress over the current configuration, integrated with det(j) — when the IR configuration is CURRENT.

plan_assets.asset_description: B1.1 UL residual equation R_i = integral(sigma_ij dN_a/dx_j dOmega - b_i v_i dOmega).

scope: Branch `emit_internal_force_kernel` on `bundle.problem_ir_dict['configuration']`: REFERENCE → current PK1 path (unchanged); CURRENT → Cauchy + spatial gradient path.
Cauchy stress is derived from the constitutive PK2 via push-forward: sigma = (1/J) F S F^T. Keep the constitutive call unchanged; do the push-forward at the emission site.
Volume element uses det(j) instead of det(J0).
Scatter: f_int[a,i] += w_q * det(j) * sigma_{ij} * dN_a/dx_j.
implementation_steps: Read the current `emit_internal_force_kernel` in `taichi_printer.py` and identify the single quadrature-point block that needs a branch.
Introduce a helper `emit_ul_force_body` that emits the UL closed form; keep the TL body untouched.
Dispatch based on the new `configuration` bundle field.

Add emission-structure tests in `tests/test_taichi_printer_ul.py`: assert the UL source contains `det(j)`, `sigma`, and spatial dN/dx; assert it does NOT contain `det(J0)` or `P = F @ S` in the UL branch.
Regenerate UL golden file (`generated_ul_svk.py.golden`) and verify it is syntactically valid Python.
acceptance_criteria: UL emission produces a syntactically valid Python file.
UL source contains the push-forward from S to sigma and uses dN/dx, det(j).
TL emission source is byte-identical to the Plan A baseline (regression guard).
No regressions on the 998 fast tests.

cases: UL internal force source contains push-forward and spatial gradients
TL emission unchanged (byte-equal to the existing golden)
UL golden snapshot parses as valid Python

risks: A bug in the push-forward sigma = F S F^T / J will propagate to the tangent and all benchmarks. Mitigation: keep a tests/ref helper that performs the same push-forward and cross-check against the handwritten UL reference added in P1-7.

commands.command: uv run pytest packages/mechdsl-core/tests/ -m 'not slow and not gpu'

completion_notes: Added _emit_ul_force_qp_inner helper to taichi_printer.py that emits the full UL QP body: current Jacobian j, spatial gradients dNdx, reference Jacobian J0 (for F), deformation gradient F, constitutive update (returns PK2 S), push-forward sigma = (1/J) F@S@F.T, scatter with detj.
Python-time configuration dispatch inside emit_internal_force_kernel: reads bundle.problem_ir_dict['configuration'] (defaults to 'reference'). Generated source is single-path (TL or UL, never both).

The UL body computes both j (current Jacobian, for dNdx + detj) and J0 (reference Jacobian, for F = I + grad_u via dN/dX). Both are needed because F_{iI} = delta_{iI} + du_i/dX_I uses reference shape gradients.
TL emission byte-identical to Plan A goldens: both generated_elastic.py.golden and generated_plastic.py.golden pass exact comparison.
New UL golden generated_ul_svk.py.golden auto-generated on first test run, then byte-compared on subsequent runs. Parses cleanly via ast.parse.

Gate B score 10/10: zero issues. The push-forward sigma = (1/J) F @ S @ F^T matches PLAN-B B1.1 exactly. The constitutive layer returns PK2 S unchanged from TL; push-forward happens at the emission site per Phase 1 Key Principle.
